Lab 3

ReAct Agent

@llm-series/tool-registry@llm-series/simple-react-agent

ToolRegistry holds Zod-validated tools. runAgent() loops: LLM reasons → picks a tool → executes it → LLM reasons again → until it has an answer.

💡 The Thought→Action→Observation loop is how LLMs use tools. Each iteration adds tool results to the conversation history.
